name: Stamp
body:
You have learned to attack with your hooves in combat.

Prerequisites: Lapith, Str 13, BAB +1.

Benefit: You are able to make an attack with your hooves as a natural secondary attack. Your hoof attacks deal a base 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
